No arrows or panel letters are visible, and individual leads are not counted here.

visual.general_description: Two-panel figure: a pacing system analysis printout with ECG, electrogram and atrial sensing channels (A) and a stacked histogram of time spent at ventricular rates by pacing category (B).
visual.detailed_description: Panel A (top) is two stacked blocks of labelled tracings with calibration labels and A M, E and P event markers. Panel B (bottom) is a histogram with a four-category hatching legend, vertical axis % of Time and horizontal axis Ventricular Rate (bpm), with one bar far taller than the rest and no printed bar values.

panels.general_description: Stacked pacing system analysis printout in two blocks of tracings (only the upper block is labelled), with E, P and A M event markers.
panels.detailed_description: Two stacked blocks of tracings with the same channel arrangement. Only the upper block carries channel labels (Lead II, EGM, Lead I, Lead III and A. Sensing) and small calibration pulses at the left showing 1 mV for the ECG and electrogram channels and 1 m/s² for A. Sensing; the lower block has no labels or calibration pulses. Above and below the top channel of each block are short vertical event markers: A over M marks sit above the trace, with E and P markers below, repeating at regular spacing across each block. The EGM channel has repeated sharp narrow downward deflections followed by smooth rounded deflections, the Lead III channel is nearly flat in the upper block and flat in the lower block, and the A. Sensing channel is a continuous noisy tracing with larger bursts recurring along its length. Dotted grid lines cross the printout. No patient name or date is visible.
